career_ladder.salary_growth_trajectory: Direct recruitment enters as Constable (Executive / Information Technology Cadre) in Central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 3 (₹21,700 – ₹69,100). The career progression moves up through Senior Constable / Head Constable (Level 4), Assistant Sub-Inspector (Level 5), Sub-Inspector (Level 6), and Inspector of Police (Level 7) as Police Station Station House Officer (SHO) or Cyber Crime/Technical cell commander, with promotional induction into Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP, Level 10) under the UT/DANIPS police service cadre.

steps.source_label: Chandigarh Police Direct Recruitment Notice 2024 (Constable IT)

steps.designation: Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP / Sub-Divisional Officer)

stages.source_label: Chandigarh Police Recruitment Notice (Constable IT) 2024 & Standing Order No. 57/2024

papers.paper_name: Tier-I: General Written Test (GK/Current Affairs, Reasoning, Numerical Ability - 100 MCQs, 100 Marks, 2 Hours; 0.25 Negative Marking; Qualifying Cut-off: 40% General, 35% SC/OBC, 30% ESM)
Tier-II: Technical Domain Test (IT Support / Electronics / Computer Applications - 50 MCQs, 50 Marks, 1 Hour; 0.25 Negative Marking; evaluated for candidates qualifying Tier-I)

stages.source_label: Chandigarh Police Standing Order No. 57/2024 (PE&MT Standards)

papers.paper_name: Physical Endurance Test: 1600m Race (6 min 15 sec for males 18-30 yrs), 800m Race (4 min 15 sec for females 18-30 yrs); Long Jump (3.95m male, 2.74m female in 3 attempts); High Jump (1.14m male, 0.90m female in 3 attempts)

Physical Measurement Test: Height (min 170 cm male, 157.5 cm female; 5 cm relaxation for Hill Areas / Wards of Police Personnel); Chest (84-88 cm male); Height Bonus (2 marks for male >= 183 cm, female >= 165 cm); NCC Bonus (5% C, 3% B, 2% A); Dope Test mandatory

stages.source_label: Chandigarh Police Document Verification & Medical Examination Instructions 2024

papers.paper_name: Document Verification: Scrutiny of Educational Degree/Diploma, Category/Caste Certificates, Valid Driving License for two-wheelers & four-wheelers (mandatory for male candidates), and Entry-level ICT Computer Skills Course Certificate

Medical Examination: Comprehensive Medical Fitness Assessment by Government Medical Board (Vision 6/6 without glasses in one eye and 6/9 in other eye; free from colour blindness, flat foot, knock knees, and other physical defects)

financial_package.pay_source_label: Chandigarh Police Constable (Executive)(IT) Recruitment Notice & Standing Order No. 57/2024

official_perks.description: Dearness Allowance at 58% of Basic Pay (₹12,586 per month as of 01.07.2025) as sanctioned by the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India for Chandigarh Administration employees.
HRA at 18% of Basic Pay (₹3,906 per month for Chandigarh City classified as Class-Y) or government allotment of departmental police residential quarters / police lines accommodation.
Transport Allowance of ₹1,350 per month plus 58% DA on TA (total ₹2,133 per month) as admissible to Level 3 central employees in Y-class cities.
Monthly ration money allowance and special duty/conveyance allowance as admissible to operational executive police personnel.
Annual uniform and clothing allowance as per central police service guidelines for executive staff.

Defined contributory pension under National Pension System (NPS Tier-I with 14% Government contribution) and cashless medical coverage at Government Multi-Specialty Hospital (GMSH) Sector 16 and GMCH Sector 32 Chandigarh.
